items.titleZh: 人工智能在痛风诊疗、药物研发和疾病监测中应用的地位、挑战与前景
items.abstractZh: 痛风是由单钠尿酸盐晶体沉积引起的慢性炎症性疾病。其全球患病率正在上升，且发病年龄呈明显提前趋势。临床管理面临若干持续挑战，包括诊断延迟、疾病评估不准确、缺乏个体化治疗策略、长期随访困难以及患者依从性欠佳。近年来，人工智能（AI）在痛风护理全过程中展现出巨大潜力。凭借其在数据处理、模式识别和预测分析方面的强大能力，AI为应对这些临床挑战提供了新方法。本综述系统整理了已发表的关于AI在痛风诊断和临床管理中应用的研究，阐述了相关工作的当前发展阶段，并概述了该领域后续研究的可行方向。

items.title: BAFF and APRIL signaling in the B-cell lineage: implications for the pathogenesis of ANCA-associated vasculitis.
items.abstract: Among the immune mechanisms underlying the pathogenesis of antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibody (ANCA)-associated vasculitis (AAV), B-lineage cells play crucial roles by producing ANCA, presenting antigens to T cells, and secreting proinflammatory cytokines. The upregulated signaling pathways of the B-cell activation factor of tumor necrosis factor family (BAFF) and a proliferation-inducing ligand (APRIL), which are broadly produced by several types of myeloid cells, contribute to the activation and survival of autoreactive B cells, leading to disease onset and relapse. Furthermore, elevated levels of soluble BAFF and APRIL persist even in patients who achieve clinical remission following conventional induction therapies such as cyclophosphamide and rituximab (RTX), resulting in the cause of relapse. Active AAV is characterized by expansions of specific phenotypes in circulating B-cell lineages, including plasmablasts and plasma cells. Conversely, reductions in transitional, memory, and regulatory B cells are observed. Significant expressions of affinity receptors binding to secreting BAFF/APRIL, including decreased BAFF receptor expression on memory B cells and transitional B cells or increased transmembrane activator and calcium-modulator and cyclophilin ligand interactor (TACI) expression on transitional B cells and plasmablasts/plasma cells, are also observed during acute and remission AAV. Enhanced BAFF and APRIL signaling through these receptors, especially TACI, activates the intracellular nuclear factor-κB pathway in B cells, promoting their proliferation and ANCA production. B-cell depletion therapy using RTX is effective; however, it requires repeated administration to maintain remission, which can occasionally lead to infection. Belimumab, a BAFF-inhibiting monoclonal antibody, alone has shown limited efficacy in preventing relapse of AAV. Targeting BAFF/APRIL signaling pathways and their binding receptors, along with the downstream molecular pathways in targeted B cells, is essential for developing novel therapeutic strategies aimed at achieving complete and sustained AAV remission.

items.title: Long-term safety of intravenous human umbilical cord blood-derived mesenchymal stem cell therapy in rheumatoid arthritis: a 5-year follow-up study.
items.abstract: Mesenchymal stem cell (MSC) therapy offers promise for treating autoimmune diseases due to its strong immunomodulatory effects. We investigated the long-term safety of a single intravenous injection with human umbilical cord blood-derived (hUCB)-MSCs in patients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA). Patients with RA who met the 2010 ACR/EULAR classification criteria and received a single intravenous infusion of hUCB-MSCs (2.5 × 107, 5.0 × 107, 1.0 × 108 cells) in a phase I trial (NCT02221258) entered this 5-year observational pilot study. Safety assessments were performed at 3, 6, and 12 months after infusion and annually thereafter. Safety endpoints included overall adverse events (AEs), serious adverse events (SAEs), and AEs of special interest. Nine patients were treated. The most common AEs were osteoarthritis (44.4%) and nasopharyngitis (44.4%). SAEs occurred in 5 patients (55.6%); a serious infection (cellulitis) occurred in 1 patient in the 1.0 × 108 group and resolved after treatment. Benign ovarian and breast tumors were reported in 2 patients 3 years post-infusion. No deaths, thromboembolism, or malignancies occurred during the follow-up period. Laboratory findings remained stable except for 1 case each of transient hypertriglyceridemia and mild eosinophilia. While DAS28 improved markedly by 3-6 months, disease activity gradually increased over 5 years, suggesting waning efficacy after a single infusion. The long-term safety profile of a single dose of intravenous hUCB-MSC in patients with RA appears acceptable; however, repeated-dose regimens may be needed for sustained disease control and further safety evaluation.

items.titleZh: 静脉注射人脐带血来源间充质干细胞治疗类风湿关节炎的长期安全性：一项5年随访研究
items.abstractZh: 间充质干细胞（MSC）疗法因其强大的免疫调节作用，为治疗自身免疫性疾病带来了希望。我们研究了类风湿关节炎（RA）患者单次静脉注射人脐带血来源（hUCB）-MSC的长期安全性。在一项I期试验（NCT02221258）中，符合2010年ACR/EULAR分类标准并接受单次静脉输注hUCB-MSC（2.5 × 107、5.0 × 107、1.0 × 108个细胞）的RA患者进入了这项为期5年的观察性初步研究。在输注后3、6和12个月以及此后每年进行安全性评估。安全性终点包括总体不良事件（AE）、严重不良事件（SAE）和特别关注的不良事件。共治疗了9名患者。最常见的不良事件是骨关节炎（44.4%）和鼻咽炎（44.4%）。5名患者（55.6%）发生SAE；1.0 × 108组中有1名患者发生严重感染（蜂窝织炎），经治疗后痊愈。输注后3年，2名患者报告了良性卵巢肿瘤和乳腺肿瘤。随访期间无死亡、血栓栓塞或恶性肿瘤发生。实验室检查结果保持稳定，仅有1例一过性高甘油三酯血症和1例轻度嗜酸性粒细胞增多。虽然DAS28在3-6个月时显著改善，但疾病活动度在5年内逐渐增加，提示单次输注后疗效逐渐减弱。RA患者单次静脉注射hUCB-MSC的长期安全性特征似乎可接受；然而，可能需要重复给药方案以实现持续的疾病控制，并需进一步评估其安全性。

items.title: An Unusual Case of Renal-Limited Giant Cell Arteritis.
items.abstract: It is widely accepted that giant cell arteritis (GCA) is a disease of the carotid branches. There are very few cases describing disseminated disease or visceral involvement. Isolated renal GCA presenting with renal failure is even more unusual. A 76-year-old male with no known medical history presented to the emergency department with three weeks of weakness, swelling, oliguria, and shortness of breath. He was started on hemodialysis for renal failure. After microscopic urinalysis revealed red blood cell casts, a kidney biopsy was performed and showed granulomatous arteritis suggestive of GCA in the renal vasculature. Despite an aggressive corticosteroid regimen, the patient remained dependent on hemodialysis until his death from an unrelated cause. The leading diagnosis throughout most of the workup in this case was end-stage renal disease in the setting of previously undiagnosed chronic kidney disease. A thorough workup revealed a far less common disease process, which significantly altered the patient's treatment course and highlighted the importance of maintaining a broad differential.

items.titleZh: 一例罕见的肾脏局限性巨细胞动脉炎
items.abstractZh: 广泛认为巨细胞动脉炎（GCA）是颈动脉分支的疾病。描述播散性疾病或内脏受累的病例非常少。以肾功能衰竭为表现的孤立性肾脏GCA更为罕见。一名76岁男性，无已知病史，因三周的乏力、肿胀、少尿和呼吸急促就诊于急诊科。他因肾功能衰竭开始接受血液透析。显微镜下尿液分析显示红细胞管型后，进行了肾活检，显示肾血管系统中提示GCA的肉芽肿性动脉炎。尽管采取了积极的糖皮质激素治疗方案，患者仍依赖血液透析，直至因无关原因死亡。在本病例的大部分检查过程中，主要诊断为既往未诊断的慢性肾脏病背景下的终末期肾病。全面的检查揭示了一个远为少见的疾病过程，这显著改变了患者的治疗过程，并强调了保持广泛鉴别诊断的重要性。

items.title: Update to the Sociedad Española de Reumatología Guidelines on the Use of Biological Therapy in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus.
items.abstract: The significant growth of information in the field of biological therapies (BT) for the treatment of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) has made it necessary to update the previous SER recommendation document. Three BTs have been approved for use in SLE. The first BT available was belimumab, with an already abundant and solid body of evidence regarding its efficacy and safety. More recently, anifrolumab was added, also backed by a robust body of evidence but with less experience of practical application. Finally, the emergence of obinutuzumab, a second-generation anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody that is more effective than rituximab and has demonstrated efficacy in lupus nephritis, has revitalised ablative therapy in SLE, although more safety data is needed before it can widely replace rituximab. Despite the lack of direct comparisons between the various biological agents available, certain differences regarding their efficacy across different disease domains, as well as in the speed of action and safety-related aspects, must be taken into account when tailoring treatment decisions. Overall, biologics have been increasingly incorporated into the treatment algorithm at earlier stages of SLE, based on their ability to improve outcomes compared to standard therapy, and are now first-line treatments for certain manifestations such as lupus nephritis.

items.titleZh: 西班牙风湿病学会关于系统性红斑狼疮生物治疗指南的更新。
items.abstractZh: 生物疗法（BT）治疗系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）领域信息的显著增长，使得有必要更新之前的SER建议文件。已有三种BT获批用于SLE。第一种可用的BT是贝利尤单抗，其疗效和安全性已有大量且坚实的证据支持。最近，阿尼鲁单抗加入，同样有强有力的证据支持，但实际应用经验较少。最后，奥滨尤妥珠单抗的出现，一种第二代抗CD20单克隆抗体，比利妥昔单抗更有效，并已在狼疮性肾炎中显示出疗效，重振了SLE中的消融治疗，尽管在广泛替代利妥昔单抗之前还需要更多的安全性数据。尽管缺乏各种可用生物制剂之间的直接比较，但在不同疾病领域的疗效、起效速度以及安全性相关方面存在某些差异，在制定个体化治疗决策时必须考虑这些差异。总体而言，基于生物制剂相比标准治疗改善结局的能力，它们已越来越多地被纳入SLE更早期阶段的治疗算法中，并且目前是某些表现（如狼疮性肾炎）的一线治疗。

items.title: Delayed diagnosis of primary cutaneous histoplasmosis in a patient receiving tumour necrosis factor alpha inhibitor therapy.
items.abstract: Primary cutaneous histoplasmosis (PCH) is a rare fungal infection, often misdiagnosed due to its polymorphic skin manifestations. We describe a woman in her 60s with rheumatoid arthritis receiving infliximab and long-term prednisone who presented with progressive, non-healing lesions of the left forearm. Initially treated as cellulitis without improvement, further investigation led to a diagnosis of PCH due to Histoplasma capsulatum confirmed by fungal culture. She was treated with systemic antifungal therapy with clinical resolution. This case underscores the importance of considering endemic fungal infections in immunocompromised individuals with persistent skin lesions, the value of early biopsy with cultures and careful management of immunosuppression.

items.titleZh: 接受肿瘤坏死因子α抑制剂治疗的患者原发性皮肤组织胞浆菌病延迟诊断一例
items.abstractZh: 原发性皮肤组织胞浆菌病（PCH）是一种罕见的真菌感染，因其多形性皮肤表现常被误诊。我们描述一位60多岁女性，患有类风湿关节炎，接受英夫利西单抗和长期泼尼松治疗，表现为左前臂进行性、不愈合的皮损。最初按蜂窝织炎治疗无改善，进一步检查通过真菌培养确诊为荚膜组织胞浆菌引起的PCH。她接受了全身抗真菌治疗，临床痊愈。本病例强调了在免疫功能低下且持续存在皮肤病变的患者中考虑地方性真菌感染的重要性，以及早期活检培养和谨慎管理免疫抑制的价值。

items.title: Therapeutic approaches for difficult-to-treat rheumatoid arthritis: a systematic literature review of current evidence.
items.abstract: This systematic literature review (SLR) aims to update the evidence regarding therapeutic strategies in difficult-to-treat rheumatoid arthritis (D2T RA), building on the previous SLR informing the European Alliance of Associations for Rheumatology (EULAR) points to consider for the management of D2T RA. Three research questions addressed efficacy or safety of treatments in patients with RA with (1) active disease and limited treatment options; (2) active disease with ≥2 prior biologic/targeted synthetic disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (b/tsDMARDs) and (3) poor health-related quality of life and low objective disease activity (non-pharmacological interventions). MEDLINE, Embase and Cochrane Library were searched until July 2025. Meta-analysis and meta-regression were conducted. We screened 8589 records and included 131 studies. For research question (RQ)1, evidence on DMARD efficacy and safety was synthesised across a wide spectrum of comorbidities including obesity, cardiovascular disease, history of malignancy and respiratory comorbidities. For RQ2, all b/tsDMARDs except otilimab demonstrated better efficacy than placebo (mostly high risk of bias). Meta-regression showed efficacy was maintained for Janus kinase inhibitors (JAKi) despite increasing number of prior bDMARD failures (1 to ≥3). Safety results confirmed the increased occurrence of infection and malignancy with JAKi. For RQ3, limited evidence suggested orthopaedic surgical intervention as a potential non-pharmacological option in patients with D2T RA. This SLR summarised evidence supporting DMARD efficacy/safety across multiple comorbidities. In patients with active RA with ≥2 prior bDMARDs, JAKi offer substantial clinical benefits but require careful risk stratification given cardiovascular and malignancy risks. Furthermore, standardised reporting and dedicated studies on non-pharmacological interventions are urgently needed. CRD42024593584.

items.titleZh: 难治性类风湿关节炎的治疗方法：当前证据的系统文献综述
items.abstractZh: 本系统文献综述（SLR）旨在更新关于难治性类风湿关节炎（D2T RA）治疗策略的证据，基于先前为欧洲风湿病学联盟（EULAR）制定D2T RA管理考虑要点提供信息的SLR。三个研究问题涉及类风湿关节炎患者治疗的有效性或安全性：（1）活动性疾病且治疗选择有限；（2）活动性疾病且既往使用≥2种生物制剂/靶向合成改善病情抗风湿药（b/tsDMARDs）；（3）健康相关生活质量差且客观疾病活动度低（非药物干预）。检索了MEDLINE、Embase和Cochrane图书馆，截止至2025年7月。进行了荟萃分析和荟萃回归。我们筛选了8589条记录，纳入131项研究。对于研究问题（RQ）1，在包括肥胖、心血管疾病、恶性肿瘤病史和呼吸系统合并症在内的广泛合并症谱系中，综合了DMARD有效性和安全性的证据。对于RQ2，除otilimab外，所有b/tsDMARDs均显示出优于安慰剂的疗效（大多存在高偏倚风险）。荟萃回归显示，尽管既往bDMARD失败次数增加（1至≥3），Janus激酶抑制剂（JAKi）的疗效仍得以维持。安全性结果证实了JAKi感染和恶性肿瘤发生率增加。对于RQ3，有限证据提示骨科手术干预可能是D2T RA患者的潜在非药物选择。本SLR总结了支持DMARD在多种合并症中有效性和安全性的证据。在既往使用≥2种bDMARDs的活动性RA患者中，JAKi提供了显著的临床获益，但鉴于心血管和恶性肿瘤风险，需要仔细进行风险分层。此外，迫切需要标准化报告和专门针对非药物干预的研究。CRD42024593584。

items.title: Sugar-coded signals: Glycan-based biomarkers in rheumatoid arthritis.
items.abstract: This review paper summarises the pathophysiology of rheumatoid arthritis (RA), its incidence and aetiology, and conventional RA protein-based biomarkers. A brief overview of novel protein-based biomarkers and biomarkers with potential to be used in the diagnostics of seronegative RA is also provided. The core of the review resides in the comprehensive characterisation of the glycosylation of immunoglobulins and their utility as novel biomarkers for the diagnostics of RA and seropositive RA. Two main approaches to the analysis of glycans present on immunoglobulins and other proteins are provided, including instrument-based and lectin-based approaches showing their clinical performance as RA biomarkers.

items.titleZh: 糖编码信号：类风湿关节炎中基于聚糖的生物标志物。
items.abstractZh: 本综述总结了类风湿关节炎（RA）的病理生理学、发病率和病因学，以及传统的基于蛋白质的RA生物标志物。还简要概述了新型基于蛋白质的生物标志物和有可能用于血清阴性RA诊断的生物标志物。综述的核心在于全面表征免疫球蛋白的糖基化及其作为RA和血清阳性RA诊断的新型生物标志物的实用性。提供了分析免疫球蛋白和其他蛋白质上聚糖的两种主要方法，包括基于仪器和基于凝集素的方法，展示了它们作为RA生物标志物的临床性能。

items.title: Serum sPD-1 and sTIM-3 as T-cell exhaustion biomarkers in systemic lupus erythematosus: the IL-6-associated exhaustion axis and the SLE Immune Exhaustion Index.
items.abstract: T-cell exhaustion marked by soluble PD-1 (sPD-1) and soluble TIM-3 (sTIM-3) has been implicated in systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), yet the cytokine mechanisms driving checkpoint-receptor upregulation, the relationship with complement consumption, and the clinical utility of these markers remain incompletely characterised. In a case-control with cross-sectional study of 120 participants (40 active SLE, 40 quiescent SLE, 40 healthy controls), serum sPD-1, sTIM-3, IL-6, ferritin, complement proteins (C3, C4, C1q), anti-dsDNA, CRP, ESR, and urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio (UPCR) were measured. A 12-parameter Spearman correlation matrix, principal component analysis (PCA) of 10 standardised biomarkers, ROC curve analysis with bootstrap 95% CIs and DeLong pairwise comparisons, lupus-nephritis (LN) subgroup analysis, and four pre-specified novel analyses were performed: (i) formal bootstrap mediation analysis of the IL-6 → sPD-1/sTIM-3 → SLEDAI-2K pathway; (ii) the sTIM-3/sPD-1 imbalance ratio; (iii) an Exhaustion-to-Complement Index (ECI); and (iv) multivariable logistic regression for LN prediction. The SLE Immune Exhaustion Index (SIEI) was evaluated by ROC analysis. Four primary biomarkers were significantly elevated in active versus quiescent SLE and healthy controls (Kruskal-Wallis H 87.2-99.0; all p < 0.001), with strong positive correlations with SLEDAI-2K (rho = 0.647-0.747). PCA identified a single dominant axis (PC1 = 78.9% variance) driven by exhaustion and inflammatory markers opposing complement proteins. Individual ROC AUCs were: sPD-1 0.932, sTIM-3 0.966, IL-6 0.944, and ferritin 0.953; the SIEI achieved 0.974, significantly exceeding sPD-1 alone (p = 0.002) but not the other individual markers. Bootstrap mediation analysis confirmed that sPD-1 and sTIM-3 each mediated approximately one-third of the IL-6 effect on SLEDAI-2K (indirect effects 0.276 and 0.303; bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero; Sobel p < 0.001). The ECI correlated strongly with SLEDAI-2K (rho = 0.86, p < 0.001; within-cohort AUC = 0.985). The UPCR plus sPD-1 plus IL-6 model significantly improved LN prediction over UPCR alone (AUC 0.869 vs 0.699; bootstrap p = 0.020), with sPD-1 carrying the dominant predictive contribution. Serum sPD-1 and sTIM-3 are closely associated with the IL-6-related, complement-consuming inflammatory network of SLE, in a pattern consistent with but not proving a mechanistic link. The SIEI is the first named, weighted composite exhaustion score in SLE, with within-cohort discrimination that requires prospective external validation. These findings support T-cell exhaustion as a serologically accessible disease axis with direct implications for disease monitoring and lupus-nephritis risk stratification.

items.title: Predicting the risk of lupus nephritis based on a nomogram in patients with childhood-onset systemic lupus erythematosus.
items.abstract: Lupus nephritis (LN) is one of the leading causes of death and a major cause of morbidity in childhood-onset systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). However, currently there is no tool to predict the risk of LN in patients with childhood-onset SLE. This study collected and retrospectively analysed data of paediatric patients who were first diagnosed with SLE at the West China Second Hospital of Sichuan University from January 2013 to December 2022. A nomogram prediction model for predicting the risk of LN was developed using LASSO-logistic regression analysis. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve, calibration curves, and decision curve analysis were used to assess the performance of the prediction model. A total of 264 paediatric patients with childhood-onset SLE were included; 171 with and 93 without LN. LASSO regression and multivariate logistic regression analyses showed that serositis, anti-dsDNA positivity, low IgG, and low albumin were independent risk factors for identifying patients at high risk for LN and were thus included in predictive models to identify such high-risk groups. The final results show that the calibration curve is close to the ideal prediction situation, and the decision curve analysis and ROC curve (AUC = 0.874) suggest that the model has good predictive power. Four indicators, serositis, anti-dsDNA positivity, low IgG, and low albumin, were independent risk factors predictive of high-risk LN in patients with childhood-onset SLE. The model has been validated internally and performs well.

items.titleZh: 基于列线图预测儿童期发病的系统性红斑狼疮患者狼疮性肾炎风险
items.abstractZh: 狼疮性肾炎（LN）是儿童期发病的系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）患者死亡的主要原因之一，也是发病的重要原因。然而，目前尚无工具可预测儿童期发病的SLE患者发生LN的风险。本研究收集并回顾性分析了2013年1月至2022年12月在四川大学华西第二医院首次诊断为SLE的儿科患者数据。采用LASSO-logistic回归分析构建了预测LN风险的列线图预测模型。使用受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线、校准曲线和决策曲线分析评估预测模型的性能。共纳入264例儿童期发病的SLE患儿，其中171例合并LN，93例无LN。LASSO回归和多因素logistic回归分析显示，浆膜炎、抗dsDNA阳性、低IgG和低白蛋白是识别LN高风险患者的独立危险因素，因此被纳入预测模型以识别此类高风险人群。最终结果显示，校准曲线接近理想预测情况，决策曲线分析和ROC曲线（AUC = 0.874）表明该模型具有良好的预测能力。浆膜炎、抗dsDNA阳性、低IgG和低白蛋白这四项指标是预测儿童期发病的SLE患者发生高风险LN的独立危险因素。该模型经过内部验证，表现良好。

items.title: Successful Prosthesis Salvage Using Continuous Local Antibiotic Perfusion (CLAP) for Prosthetic Joint Infection Following Revision Total Elbow Arthroplasty in a Patient with Rheumatoid Arthritis: A Case Report.
items.abstract: Prosthetic joint infection (PJI) represents a serious and challenging complication in a patient with rheumatoid arthritis (RA). We report a case of PJI following revision total elbow arthroplasty (TEA) with RA that was successfully managed with debridement, antibiotics, and implant retention (DAIR) augmented by continuous local antibiotic perfusion (CLAP). A 69-year-old woman with a 39-year history of RA previously underwent revision TEA for aseptic loosening. Two years following the revision surgery, she developed left elbow swelling, pain, and erythema, resulting in a diagnosis of PJI. Because the implant remained stable without evidence of loosening, an emergency DAIR procedure was performed in conjunction with CLAP in attempt to salvage the prosthesis. Intraoperative cultures were positive for methicillin-susceptible Staphylococcus aureus. Following surgery, the patient received targeted systemic antibiotic therapy alongside continuous local gentamicin perfusion via CLAP system. Local perfusion was discontinued on postoperative day 18, and oral antibiotic suppressive therapy was continued for three months. At the two-year follow-up examination, the patient showed no clinical evidence of recurrent infection and had maintained her preoperative elbow range of motion. The integration of CLAP with the DAIR procedure represents a promising, prosthesis-preserving therapeutic strategy for managing PJI following revision TEA.

items.titleZh: 使用连续局部抗生素灌注（CLAP）成功挽救类风湿关节炎患者翻修全肘关节置换术后假体关节感染的假体：病例报告。
items.abstractZh: 假体关节感染（PJI）是类风湿关节炎（RA）患者中一种严重且具有挑战性的并发症。我们报告一例RA患者翻修全肘关节置换术（TEA）后发生PJI，通过清创、抗生素和假体保留（DAIR）联合连续局部抗生素灌注（CLAP）成功治疗。一名有39年RA病史的69岁女性，既往因无菌性松动接受了翻修TEA。翻修手术后两年，她出现左肘肿胀、疼痛和红斑，诊断为PJI。由于假体保持稳定且无松动迹象，进行了急诊DAIR手术并联合CLAP以尝试挽救假体。术中培养为甲氧西林敏感金黄色葡萄球菌阳性。术后，患者接受了针对性的全身抗生素治疗，同时通过CLAP系统进行连续局部庆大霉素灌注。局部灌注于术后第18天停止，口服抗生素抑制治疗持续三个月。在两年随访时，患者无临床复发感染证据，并保持了术前肘关节活动范围。CLAP与DAIR手术的整合代表了一种有前景的、保留假体的治疗策略，用于处理翻修TEA后的PJI。

items.title: Clinical outcomes after switching from mepolizumab to benralizumab in eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis: A single-centre retrospective cohort study.
items.abstract: To investigate the impact of switching to benralizumab on flare risk in patients with eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis (EGPA) previously treated with mepolizumab. We conducted a single-centre retrospective cohort study including 26 patients with EGPA who received mepolizumab. A landmark analysis was performed at 910 days after mepolizumab initiation (median time to switching), and patients were grouped according to treatment. The primary outcome was disease flares requiring treatment intensification. We used a Cox model with treatment switching as a time-dependent covariate. In the landmark analysis, the benralizumab group (n=4) had a higher flare rate than the mepolizumab group (n=10) (log-rank test, P = 0.002). However, the Cox model did not converge and the time-dependent analysis yielded an imprecise estimate (hazard ratio 3.14, 95% confidence interval 0.31-32.02). The 1-year flare-free rate after switching to benralizumab (n=19) was 94.1%, and no severe flares occurred. Most patients had low disease activity at switching, and switching was primarily driven by patient preference. Short-term flare-free survival after switching to benralizumab was high despite a small number of minor flares. Further evidence is warranted to assess long-term outcomes.

items.titleZh: 从美泊利珠单抗转换为贝那利珠单抗在嗜酸性肉芽肿性多血管炎中的临床结局：一项单中心回顾性队列研究。
items.abstractZh: 旨在调查既往接受美泊利珠单抗治疗的嗜酸性肉芽肿性多血管炎（EGPA）患者转换为贝那利珠单抗对发作风险的影响。我们进行了一项单中心回顾性队列研究，纳入26例接受美泊利珠单抗治疗的EGPA患者。在美泊利珠单抗起始治疗后910天（中位转换时间）进行了里程碑分析，并根据治疗对患者进行分组。主要结局是需要强化治疗的疾病发作。我们使用以治疗转换作为时间依赖性协变量的Cox模型。在里程碑分析中，贝那利珠单抗组（n=4）的发作率高于美泊利珠单抗组（n=10）（对数秩检验，P = 0.002）。然而，Cox模型未收敛，时间依赖性分析产生了不精确的估计（风险比3.14，95%置信区间0.31-32.02）。转换为贝那利珠单抗后（n=19）的1年无发作率为94.1%，且未发生严重发作。大多数患者在转换时疾病活动度低，转换主要由患者偏好驱动。尽管有少量轻微发作，转换为贝那利珠单抗后的短期无发作生存率较高。需要进一步证据来评估长期结局。

items.title: Diagnostic methods of rheumatoid arthritis-associated interstitial lung disease: a systematic review.
items.abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis-associated interstitial lung disease (RA-ILD) is a potentially life-threatening extra-articular complication affecting 10-60% of patients with rheumatoid arthritis. Despite its clinical significance, the optimal diagnostic strategy remains uncertain. This systematic review assessed the diagnostic value of currently available methods for detecting RA-ILD. The review followed PRISMA guidelines. Databases were searched for studies evaluating imaging modalities (chest X-ray, high-resolution computed tomography [HRCT], lung ultrasound), pulmonary function tests (forced vital capacity [FVC], total lung capacity [TLC], diffusing capacity for carbon monoxide [DLCO]), clinical features, and serum biomarkers. The risk of bias was assessed using QUADAS-2 tool.Thirty-six studies were included. Risk of bias was low in 20, high in 1, and unclear in 15 studies. Applicability concerns were low in 18, unclear in 17 and high in 1 study. Lung ultrasound was most frequently evaluated, showing sensitivity of 70-100% and specificity of 56-97%. Only one HRCT study was identified; it demonstrated high specificity but moderate sensitivity for detecting a UIP pattern. No studies assessing lung volumes (FVC, TLC) were found. DLCO showed sensitivity for RA-ILD detection but limited specificity and uncertain optimal cut-off values. Among biomarkers, KL-6 was most studied (sensitivity 61-100%, specificity 78-91%), while other biomarkers demonstrated inconsistent results and lacked validation. Lung ultrasound appears diagnostically useful in RA-ILD. Evidence supporting pulmonary function tests is limited. Although KL-6 shows promise, biomarkers cannot currently serve as standalone diagnostic tools. Further well-designed prospective studies are required.  https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420251035610 .

items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎相关间质性肺病的诊断方法：一项系统评价。
items.abstractZh: 类风湿关节炎相关间质性肺病（RA-ILD）是一种可能危及生命的关节外并发症，影响10-60%的类风湿关节炎患者。尽管其临床意义重大，但最佳诊断策略仍不确定。本系统评价评估了当前可用方法检测RA-ILD的诊断价值。该评价遵循PRISMA指南。检索了评估影像学检查（胸部X线、高分辨率计算机断层扫描[HRCT]、肺部超声）、肺功能检查（用力肺活量[FVC]、肺总量[TLC]、一氧化碳弥散量[DLCO]）、临床特征和血清生物标志物的研究。使用QUADAS-2工具评估偏倚风险。共纳入36项研究。20项研究偏倚风险低，1项高，15项不清楚。适用性担忧在18项研究中低，17项不清楚，1项高。肺部超声评估最多，显示敏感性为70-100%，特异性为56-97%。仅发现一项HRCT研究；该研究显示检测UIP模式具有高特异性但中等敏感性。未发现评估肺容量（FVC、TLC）的研究。DLCO显示对RA-ILD检测具有敏感性，但特异性有限且最佳截断值不确定。在生物标志物中，KL-6研究最多（敏感性61-100%，特异性78-91%），而其他生物标志物结果不一致且缺乏验证。肺部超声在RA-ILD中似乎具有诊断价值。支持肺功能检查的证据有限。尽管KL-6显示出前景，但生物标志物目前不能作为独立的诊断工具。需要进一步设计良好的前瞻性研究。https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420251035610 。

items.title: Primary Cutaneous Gamma-Delta T-Cell Lymphoma Complicating Long-Standing Immunosuppressed Dermatomyositis.
items.abstract: Primary cutaneous gamma-delta T-cell lymphoma (PCGD-TCL) is a rare cytotoxic lymphoma with key oncogenic drivers in the JAK/STAT pathway. Also primarily involving the subcutaneous adipose tissue, subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma (SPTCL) is more frequently encountered in scenarios of autoimmune disorders. SPTCL shares clinicopathologic overlap with lupus panniculitis. However, the link between autoimmunity and PCGD-TCL is much less established, particularly in the setting of long-standing, immunosuppressed dermatomyositis (DM). We report two cases of PCGD-TCL arising in women with chronic anti-TIF1-γ DM following years of immunosuppressive therapy. Case 1 is a 47-year-old woman with a 19-year history of DM on azathioprine/prednisone who developed rapidly progressive, painful subcutaneous nodules. Incisional biopsy confirmed a TCR-delta+, CD8+ cytotoxic T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder (TCLPD) compatible with PCGD-TCL. She achieved complete remission following pralatrexate and subsequent allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant. Case 2 is a 27-year-old woman with DM on mycophenolate/rituximab who developed subcutaneous nodules with an indolent course and some spontaneous regression. A biopsy revealed a similar panniculitic infiltrate with an atypical TCR-delta+, CD8+ phenotype. Notably, both cases were negative for high-risk JAK/STAT pathway mutations. These cases identify PCGD-TCLPD/TCL as a potential complication of chronic, immunosuppressed DM. The shared, atypical CD8+ immunophenotype and absence of canonical driver mutations suggest a distinct pathogenic mechanism possibly linked to long-term immune modulation. Unlike classic PCGD-TCL, which is characterized by an aggressive course and < 2-year median survival, the clinical courses in these two cases were variable, with one requiring transplant and the other showing indolent behavior and responsiveness to therapy.

items.titleZh: 原发性皮肤γ-δ T细胞淋巴瘤并发长期免疫抑制的皮肌炎
items.abstractZh: 原发性皮肤γ-δ T细胞淋巴瘤（PCGD-TCL）是一种罕见的细胞毒性淋巴瘤，其关键致癌驱动因子位于JAK/STAT通路。同样主要累及皮下脂肪组织的皮下脂膜炎样T细胞淋巴瘤（SPTCL）在自身免疫性疾病中更为常见。SPTCL与狼疮性脂膜炎有临床病理重叠。然而，自身免疫与PCGD-TCL之间的联系远未明确，尤其是在长期免疫抑制的皮肌炎（DM）背景下。我们报告了两例在慢性抗TIF1-γ DM女性患者中，经过多年免疫抑制治疗后出现的PCGD-TCL病例。病例1为47岁女性，有19年DM病史，接受硫唑嘌呤/泼尼松治疗，出现快速进展的疼痛性皮下结节。切开活检证实为TCR-δ+、CD8+细胞毒性T细胞淋巴增殖性疾病（TCLPD），符合PCGD-TCL。她在接受普拉曲沙及随后的异基因造血干细胞移植后达到完全缓解。病例2为27岁女性，DM患者，接受霉酚酸酯/利妥昔单抗治疗，出现皮下结节，病程惰性，部分自发消退。活检显示类似的脂膜炎样浸润，伴有非典型TCR-δ+、CD8+表型。值得注意的是，两例均未检测到高风险JAK/STAT通路突变。这些病例表明PCGD-TCLPD/TCL可能是慢性免疫抑制DM的潜在并发症。共有的非典型CD8+免疫表型和缺乏典型驱动突变提示可能存在与长期免疫调节相关的独特致病机制。与以侵袭性病程和<2年中位生存期为特征的经典PCGD-TCL不同，这两例的临床病程各异，一例需要移植，另一例表现为惰性行为并对治疗有反应。

items.title: Patients with Psoriatic Arthritis Have Increased Dental Comorbidities: A Nationwide Population-based Cohort Study in Korea.
items.abstract: Psoriatic arthritis is increasingly recognized as a systemic inflammatory disease with multiple comorbidities, yet the full spectrum of dental complications associated with psoriatic arthritis has not been clearly defined. This nationwide population based cohort study evaluated whether patients with psoriatic arthritis are at elevated risk of diverse dental diseases. Using a nationwide population-based health insurance database, we identified 40,920 newly diagnosed psoriatic arthritis cases and 204,468 age- and sex-matched controls. Dental outcomes included dental caries, pulp and periapical disease, periodontal disease, gingival changes and tooth loss. Cox proportional hazards models were used to estimate adjusted hazard ratios (aHRs). PsA patients exhibited significantly increased risks of dental caries (aHR 1.342), pulp and periapical disease (aHR 1.633) and periodontal disease (aHR 1.268). Subtype analyses revealed elevated risks for acute and chronic gingivitis, aggressive and chronic periodontitis, periodontosis and unspecified periodontal disease. These findings highlight the need for comprehensive oral health surveillance in patients with psoriatic arthritis.

items.titleZh: 银屑病关节炎患者牙科合并症增加：韩国一项全国性基于人群的队列研究
items.abstractZh: 银屑病关节炎日益被认为是具有多种合并症的全身性炎症性疾病，但与其相关的牙科并发症的完整谱系尚未明确。这项全国性基于人群的队列研究评估了银屑病关节炎患者是否面临多种牙科疾病的更高风险。利用全国性基于人群的健康保险数据库，我们确定了40,920例新诊断的银屑病关节炎病例和204,468例年龄和性别匹配的对照者。牙科结局包括龋齿、牙髓和根尖周疾病、牙周疾病、牙龈改变和牙齿脱落。使用Cox比例风险模型估计调整后的风险比（aHRs）。银屑病关节炎患者表现出龋齿（aHR 1.342）、牙髓和根尖周疾病（aHR 1.633）以及牙周疾病（aHR 1.268）的风险显著增加。亚型分析显示，急性和慢性牙龈炎、侵袭性和慢性牙周炎、牙周变性及未特指牙周疾病的风险升高。这些发现强调了对银屑病关节炎患者进行综合口腔健康监测的必要性。

items.title: Metabolic exhaustion and immune ageing in rheumatoid arthritis.
items.abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) disproportionately affects adults over 50 years of age, highlighting how age-related immune remodelling undermines tolerance and promotes autoreactivity. In later adulthood, immune cells progressively lose metabolic resilience because of impaired nutrient sensing, reduced metabolic flexibility and disrupted anabolic-catabolic balance. In RA, these vulnerabilities are compounded by mitochondrial insufficiency across innate and adaptive immune lineages, creating a state of nutrient deprivation characterized by NAD⁺ and ATP scarcity and diversion of carbon away from oxidative phosphorylation. Mechanistic studies identify this bioenergetic fragility as a core defect that limits cellular longevity and promotes inflammatory, non-apoptotic death pathways, including pyroptosis and PANoptosis. The hypoxic, nutrient-restricted synovial environment adds pressure that exceeds the diminished metabolic adaptability of aged immune cells. In RA T cells, accelerated mitochondrial injury initiates maladaptive stress responses, disrupts mitochondria-lysosome-endoplasmic reticulum communication and induces gasdermin D-dependent pore formation and inflammatory lysis. Synovial MerTK⁺ reparative macrophages undergo a parallel metabolic crisis, whereby autocrine C1q sensing activates mitochondrial SARM1, causing NAD⁺ degradation, ATP depletion and PANoptotic cell death. Together, these findings position ageing-associated metabolic exhaustion and organelle disintegration as unifying mechanisms that convert immune cells into tissue-damaging effectors and explain the heightened susceptibility to RA in older adults.

items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎中的代谢耗竭与免疫衰老
items.abstractZh: 类风湿关节炎（RA）不成比例地影响50岁以上的成年人，凸显了年龄相关的免疫重塑如何破坏耐受性并促进自身反应性。在成年后期，由于营养感知受损、代谢灵活性降低以及合成代谢-分解代谢平衡紊乱，免疫细胞逐渐失去代谢弹性。在RA中，这些脆弱性因先天性和适应性免疫谱系中的线粒体功能不全而加剧，形成一种以NAD⁺和ATP缺乏以及碳从氧化磷酸化转移为特征的营养剥夺状态。机制研究确定这种生物能量脆弱性是限制细胞寿命并促进炎症性、非凋亡性死亡途径（包括焦亡和PANoptosis）的核心缺陷。缺氧、营养受限的滑膜环境增加了超出衰老免疫细胞减弱的代谢适应能力的压力。在RA T细胞中，加速的线粒体损伤引发适应不良的应激反应，破坏线粒体-溶酶体-内质网通讯，并诱导gasdermin D依赖性孔形成和炎症性裂解。滑膜MerTK⁺修复性巨噬细胞经历平行的代谢危机，其中自分泌C1q感知激活线粒体SARM1，导致NAD⁺降解、ATP耗竭和PANoptotic细胞死亡。总之，这些发现将衰老相关的代谢耗竭和细胞器崩解定位为将免疫细胞转化为组织损伤效应器的统一机制，并解释了老年人对RA易感性增加的原因。

items.title: Dapagliflozin in lupus nephritis: renal and hematologic outcomes from a randomized controlled trial.
items.abstract: Lupus nephritis (LN) remains a major cause of chronic kidney disease (CKD) and end-stage renal disease despite advances in immunosuppressive therapy. Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors confer renal protection in diabetic and nondiabetic CKD and have been associated with increases in hemoglobin levels, but their renal and hematologic effects in immune-mediated glomerulopathies such as LN are not well defined. To evaluate the renal and hematologic effects, efficacy, and safety of dapagliflozin as adjunctive therapy in patients with LN. In this randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, 79 adult patients with biopsy-proven LN and estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) >30 ml/min/1.73 m 2 were randomized to receive dapagliflozin 10 mg/day ( n  = 38) or placebo ( n  = 41) for 12 months in addition to standard immunosuppressive therapy. The primary renal endpoint was percentage change in 24-h urinary protein excretion. Secondary renal outcomes included change in eGFR. Hematologic parameters assessed at baseline and 12 months included hemoglobin, erythropoietin, hepcidin, ferritin, and transferrin saturation. The primary analysis used analysis of covariance (ANCOVA) with adjustment for baseline values and clinically relevant covariates including age and background immunosuppressive therapy. Sensitivity analyses using log-transformed proteinuria were also performed. Additional analyses evaluated adjusted 12-month eGFR and eGFR slope. At 12 months, dapagliflozin was associated with a numerical reduction in proteinuria compared with placebo; however, this difference did not reach statistical significance. Adjusted analyses using ANCOVA confirmed the absence of a significant treatment effect. No significant differences were observed in eGFR, eGFR slope, or hematologic parameters. In this randomized controlled trial, dapagliflozin was associated with a numerical reduction in proteinuria that did not reach statistical significance after adjustment for baseline characteristics and background immunosuppressive therapy. No significant effect on kidney function, eGFR slope, or hematologic parameters was observed. These findings suggest a possible signal that requires confirmation in larger, adequately powered, longer-duration studies.Clinical trials registration number: NCT05748925 (ClinicalTrials.gov). Registered 28 February 2023-Retrospectively registered (https://register.clinicaltrials.gov/prs/beta/studies/S000CWI200000138/recordSummary).

items.titleZh: 达格列净治疗狼疮性肾炎：一项随机对照试验的肾脏和血液学结局
items.abstractZh: 尽管免疫抑制治疗取得了进展，狼疮性肾炎（LN）仍是慢性肾脏病（CKD）和终末期肾病的主要原因。钠-葡萄糖协同转运蛋白2（SGLT2）抑制剂在糖尿病和非糖尿病CKD中具有肾脏保护作用，并与血红蛋白水平升高相关，但其在LN等免疫介导的肾小球疾病中的肾脏和血液学效应尚未明确。为评估达格列净作为LN患者辅助治疗的肾脏和血液学效应、疗效及安全性，本随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验将79例经活检证实为LN且估算肾小球滤过率（eGFR）>30 ml/min/1.73 m²的成年患者随机分配至达格列净10 mg/天（n=38）或安慰剂（n=41）组，治疗12个月，同时接受标准免疫抑制治疗。主要肾脏终点为24小时尿蛋白排泄的百分比变化。次要肾脏结局包括eGFR的变化。在基线和12个月时评估的血液学参数包括血红蛋白、促红细胞生成素、铁调素、铁蛋白和转铁蛋白饱和度。主要分析采用协方差分析（ANCOVA），调整基线值和临床相关协变量，包括年龄和背景免疫抑制治疗。还进行了使用对数转换蛋白尿的敏感性分析。额外分析评估了调整后的12个月eGFR和eGFR斜率。在12个月时，与安慰剂相比，达格列净与蛋白尿的数值性降低相关；然而，该差异未达到统计学显著性。使用ANCOVA的调整分析确认了无显著治疗效应。在eGFR、eGFR斜率或血液学参数方面未观察到显著差异。在本随机对照试验中，达格列净与蛋白尿的数值性降低相关，但在调整基线特征和背景免疫抑制治疗后未达到统计学显著性。未观察到对肾功能、eGFR斜率或血液学参数的显著影响。这些发现提示可能存在一个信号，需要在更大规模、充分把握度、更长持续时间的研究中加以确认。临床试验注册号：NCT05748925（ClinicalTrials.gov）。注册日期：2023年2月28日——回顾性注册（https://register.clinicaltrials.gov/prs/beta/studies/S000CWI200000138/recordSummary）。

items.title: Case Report: Overlapping multiple sclerosis and neuropsychiatric systemic lupus erythematosus with positive MOG-IgG: a case initially misdiagnosed as depression.
items.abstract: We present a 69-year-old female patient who initially manifested with depression and anhedonia, initially misdiagnosed as primary psychiatric illness. She subsequently developed progressive gait instability and cognitive decline. After comprehensive clinical and laboratory evaluation, she was finally diagnosed with multiple sclerosis (MS) complicated by neuropsychiatric systemic lupus erythematosus (NPSLE). Brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) revealed multifocal white matter lesions consistent with demyelination. Serologic testing demonstrated positivity for antinuclear antibody (ANA), anti-double-stranded DNA (dsDNA), anti-SS-A/Ro, anti-histone, anti-nucleosome, and anti-centromere antibodies. Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) examination confirmed intrathecal synthesis of immunoglobulin G (IgG), as evidenced by CSF-restricted oligoclonal bands (OCBs). Serum myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein immunoglobulin G (MOG-IgG) was positive at a titer of 1:32, whereas aquaporin-4 (AQP4) antibodies were negative. Based on the clinical manifestations, laboratory results and disease progression, the final diagnosis was established as coexisting MS and NPSLE. The patient achieved clinical improvement after treatment with glucocorticoids and hydroxychloroquine. This case highlights the diagnostic challenges posed by overlapping autoimmune central nervous system (CNS) disorders and underscores the importance of longitudinal assessment in differentiating MS from MOG-IgG-associated disorder (MOGAD) and NPSLE.

items.titleZh: 病例报告：多发性硬化与伴MOG-IgG阳性的神经精神性系统性红斑狼疮重叠：一例最初被误诊为抑郁症的病例
items.abstractZh: 我们报告一例69岁女性患者，最初表现为抑郁和快感缺失，被误诊为原发性精神疾病。随后出现进行性步态不稳和认知功能下降。经过全面的临床和实验室评估，最终诊断为多发性硬化（MS）合并神经精神性系统性红斑狼疮（NPSLE）。头颅磁共振成像（MRI）显示多灶性白质病变，符合脱髓鞘改变。血清学检测显示抗核抗体（ANA）、抗双链DNA（dsDNA）、抗SS-A/Ro、抗组蛋白、抗核小体和抗着丝点抗体阳性。脑脊液（CSF）检查证实鞘内免疫球蛋白G（IgG）合成，表现为CSF-限制性寡克隆区带（OCBs）。血清髓鞘少突胶质细胞糖蛋白免疫球蛋白G（MOG-IgG）滴度为1:32阳性，而水通道蛋白-4（AQP4）抗体阴性。基于临床表现、实验室结果和疾病进展，最终诊断为MS与NPSLE共存。患者经糖皮质激素和羟氯喹治疗后获得临床改善。本病例强调了自身免疫性中枢神经系统（CNS）疾病重叠带来的诊断挑战，并强调了纵向评估在区分MS与MOG-IgG相关疾病（MOGAD）和NPSLE中的重要性。

items.title: CCR1-mediated monocyte chemotaxis in the immunopathology of primary Sjögren's syndrome: multi-omics integration analysis and computational target prioritization implicating Polygonatum odoratum .
items.abstract: Primary Sjögren's syndrome (pSS) is a chronic systemic autoimmune disease with no specific etiological treatment. Polygonatum odoratum , a traditional yin-nourishing herb, is used in treating pSS, but its molecular mechanism remains unclear. This study aimed to explore the potential association of CCR1 with pSS immunopathology and to computationally assess its candidacy as a predicted target of P. odoratum. Transcriptomic datasets (GSE51092, GSE66795; validation: GSE84844) and single-cell RNA sequencing data (GSE253568) were obtained from GEO. Network pharmacology screened active component targets of P. odoratum, and a "three-dimensional intersection" strategy identified candidate therapeutic targets. Single-cell analyses including monocyte subtyping, pseudotime trajectory, SCENIC transcription factor network, and CellChat cell communication analyses were performed. Molecular docking predicted drug-target binding, and RT-qPCR validated findings in clinical samples (pSS n = 65, HC n = 48). CCR1 was the only candidate target simultaneously satisfying "drug-targetable, disease-related, and differentially expressed" conditions. CCR1 was significantly upregulated in pSS patients (AUC = 0.758, indicating moderate discriminatory capacity) and positively correlated with serum IgG levels (R = 0.49, P = 0.0057). Single-cell analysis demonstrated CCR1 was specifically highly expressed in classical monocytes (CD14++CD16-), with CCR1-positive monocytes significantly expanded in pSS (P = 0.0079). SCENIC analysis predicted STAT1 and EGR1 as candidate upstream transcription factors potentially associated with CCR1 expression. CellChat analysis predicted a potential "T/NK cell-derived CCL5-CCR1-mediated monocyte chemotactic recruitment" signaling axis. Moupinamide from P. odoratum showed predicted binding affinity with CCR1 (-8.1 kcal/mol). RT-qPCR confirmed elevated CCR1 expression in pSS PBMCs (P < 0.0001). This study provides exploratory multi-dimensional evidence consistent with a candidate role of CCR1 in pSS immunopathology. CCR1 is predominantly expressed in classical monocytes, predicted to be associated with STAT1/EGR1 regulatory activity, and computationally linked to monocyte recruitment through the CCL5-CCR1 chemotactic axis. Pseudotime analysis suggested a computational inference of monocyte differentiation trajectory differences associated with CCR1 expression dynamics, requiring experimental validation. Moupinamide from P. odoratum shows predicted binding affinity to CCR1, offering a computational hypothesis for the "yin-nourishing and dryness-moistening" therapeutic principle that warrants experimental validation.

items.title: Immunological heterogeneity in rheumatoid arthritis: challenges in early-stage stratification, non-response to targeted therapy, and the restoration of immune tolerance.
items.abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a systemic autoimmune disease characterized by chronic erosive synovitis, progressive bone destruction, and marked inter-patient heterogeneity in disease course and treatment response. This review critically examines the mechanisms underlying RA immunological heterogeneity, including genetic susceptibility, epigenetic regulation, autoantibody diversification, synovial pathotypes, and gut-joint axis-related immune-metabolic interactions. We further discuss how peripheral blood multi-omics, synovial molecular pathology, and biopsy-driven clinical trial evidence may inform early stratification and prediction of primary non-response. Rather than proposing a deterministic precision-medicine model, this review emphasizes an evidence-weighted framework in which molecular and tissue-level biomarkers are integrated with clinical phenotype and longitudinal treatment response. Emerging approaches, including pharmacomicrobiomics, local drug delivery, nanomedicine, and cell-based therapies, are evaluated as investigational strategies that require further validation. Overall, this review highlights how a more critical understanding of RA heterogeneity may improve patient stratification and support more rational therapeutic selection.

items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎的免疫异质性：早期分层、靶向治疗无应答及免疫耐受恢复中的挑战
items.abstractZh: 类风湿关节炎（RA）是一种系统性自身免疫性疾病，其特征为慢性侵蚀性滑膜炎、进行性骨破坏，以及病程和治疗反应方面显著的患者间异质性。本综述批判性地探讨了RA免疫异质性背后的机制，包括遗传易感性、表观遗传调控、自身抗体多样化、滑膜病理类型以及肠-关节轴相关的免疫-代谢相互作用。我们进一步讨论了外周血多组学、滑膜分子病理学以及活检驱动的临床试验证据如何可能为早期分层和原发性无应答的预测提供信息。本综述并未提出一种确定性的精准医学模型，而是强调一种证据加权框架，在该框架中，分子和组织水平的生物标志物与临床表型及纵向治疗反应相结合。新兴方法，包括药物微生物组学、局部药物递送、纳米医学和细胞疗法，被评估为需要进一步验证的研究性策略。总体而言，本综述强调了更批判性地理解RA异质性如何可能改善患者分层并支持更合理的治疗选择。

items.title: Fibrotic remodeling in the NOD/ShiLtJ mouse model of Sjögren's disease: insights from single-cell transcriptomics and AI-driven ECM quantification.
items.abstract: Sjögren's Disease (SjD) is an autoimmune disorder characterized by salivary gland hypofunction and lymphocytic infiltration, yet the contribution of fibrosis to glandular dysfunction remains unclear. We evaluated the NOD/ShiLtJ mouse as a model for salivary gland fibrosis and used it to examine the impact of antifibrotic therapy on extracellular matrix (ECM) remodeling. To assess therapeutic potential, we treated NOD/ShiLtJ female mice with nintedanib, an FDA-approved antifibrotic agent used to treat chronic fibrosing interstitial lung disease. Fibrosis was assessed using single-cell RNA sequencing combined with Picrosirius red staining and AI-assisted digital pathology quantification of collagen I patterning with FibroNest. Single-cell RNA sequencing revealed that fibroblast populations in the submandibular and sublingual salivary glands of the female NOD/ShiLtJ mouse exhibited increased levels of ECM genes, including Col1a1 , Col1a2 , and Col3a1 , relative to control mice. Consistent with these transcriptional changes, Picrosirius Red staining, combined with AI-assisted fibrosis quantification of collagen I patterns, demonstrated significant fibrotic remodeling in the periacinar ECM in submandibular glands of female NOD/ShiLtJ mice relative to controls. Notably, fibrosis severity strongly correlated with the diabetic phenotype characteristic of this strain, and both periductal and periacinar fibrosis progressed with age. An 8-week nintedanib treatment resulted in modest but measurable reductions across multiple fibrotic indices. Collectively, these findings establish the NOD/ShiLtJ strain as a model of SjD-associated salivary gland fibrosis and provide proof-of-concept evidence supporting antifibrotic strategies as a potential therapeutic avenue for salivary gland dysfunction in SjD.

items.title: Celastrol Ameliorates Systemic Lupus Erythematosus via Restoring Nt5e/ adenosine-dependent Th17/Treg Balance.
items.abstract: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is a chronic autoimmune disease characterized by the breakdown of immune tolerance, systemic inflammation, and multi-organ damage. The imbalance between T helper 17 (Th17) cells and regulatory T (Treg) cells is a key driver in SLE pathogenesis. This study aimed to investigate whether Celastrol (Cel), a natural triterpenoid derived from Tripterygium wilfordii, exerts therapeutic effects in SLE by modulating the Th17/Treg balance, and to explore the underlying molecular mechanism. An in vivo study using the MRL/lpr lupus-prone mouse model was conducted to evaluate therapeutic efficacy, complemented by in vitro assays and molecular analysis to identify target pathways. MRL/lpr mice were orally administered Cel and disease progression was assessed via survival analysis, spleen pathology, autoantibody levels, and renal histopathology. T cell subsets were analyzed using flow cytometry and Western blot. Proteomic profiling was performed to identify potential molecular targets, followed by molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), MicroScale Thermophoresis (MST) and surface plasmon resonance (SPR) to validate target engagement. AB680, a pharmacological inhibitor of ecto-5'-nucleotidase (Nt5e), was used to confirm the functional role of Nt5e. Cel treatment significantly improved survival, reduced splenomegaly, suppressed anti-dsDNA/ANA autoantibody levels, and alleviated renal damage in lupus-prone mice. It promoted Treg cell differentiation and inhibited Th17 polarization, evidenced by increased Foxp3 expression and decreased STAT3 phosphorylation. Nt5e was identified as a direct binding target of Cel. Target engagement was validated through CETSA, MST and SPR, and inhibition of Nt5e by AB680 partially reversed Cel's therapeutic effects, indicating that Nt5e mediates its immunomodulatory action. Our results indicate that Cel restores the Th17/Treg balance via upregulating Nt5e, thereby ameliorating SLE-associated injury. This study thus provides novel insights into the mechanism of Cel treating SLE and underscores the therapeutic potential of targeting Nt5e in SLE.

items.title: Two Cases of Eosinophilic Granulomatosis With Polyangiitis Presenting With Rhinologic Manifestations.
items.abstract: Eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis (EGPA) frequently presents with asthma and sinusitis, making otorhinolaryngologic manifestations potential early indicators of systemic vasculitis. However, these manifestations are often misdiagnosed as common inflammatory diseases. We report two cases of EGPA diagnosed based on distinct rhinologic presentations. The first case involved a 52-year-old woman who developed mononeuritis multiplex and cutaneous vasculitis following surgery for nasal polyps, which ultimately led to a definitive diagnosis of EGPA. The second case involved a 39-year-old woman who presented with nasal septal perforation and was subsequently diagnosed with an acute exacerbation of EGPA accompanied by pulmonary infiltrates. These cases highlight that not only nasal polyps but also atypical findings, such as nasal septal perforation, may serve as critical diagnostic clues for EGPA. Otorhinolaryngologists play a pivotal role in identifying this potentially fatal systemic vasculitis through careful evaluation of localized sinonasal manifestations.

items.titleZh: 以鼻科表现为首发症状的嗜酸性肉芽肿性多血管炎两例
items.abstractZh: 嗜酸性肉芽肿性多血管炎（EGPA）常以哮喘和鼻窦炎为首发表现，使得耳鼻喉科表现可能成为系统性血管炎的早期指标。然而，这些表现常被误诊为常见的炎症性疾病。我们报告两例基于不同鼻科表现而确诊的EGPA病例。第一例为一名52岁女性，在鼻息肉手术后出现多发性单神经炎和皮肤血管炎，最终明确诊断为EGPA。第二例为一名39岁女性，表现为鼻中隔穿孔，随后被诊断为EGPA急性加重并伴有肺部浸润。这些病例强调，不仅鼻息肉，非典型表现如鼻中隔穿孔也可能成为EGPA的关键诊断线索。耳鼻喉科医生通过仔细评估局部鼻窦表现，在识别这种可能致命的系统性血管炎中发挥着关键作用。

items.title: Calcinosis of the Gastrocnemius Muscle in Juvenile Dermatomyositis: A Case Report of Successful Surgical Treatment.
items.abstract: Juvenile dermatomyositis is a rare pediatric inflammatory myopathy characterized by proximal muscle weakness and typical skin lesions. Although most patients achieve remission, up to 40% develop calcinosis, which may cause significant long-term morbidity. Management remains challenging, and surgical intervention is generally discouraged due to the risk of recurrence, ectopic ossification, and functional impairment. This case describes a 45-year-old man with a history of juvenile dermatomyositis in long-term remission who developed a spontaneous, painless swelling of the right calf. Imaging revealed extensive calcifications and soft tissue edema within the gastrocnemius muscle, initially interpreted as a hematoma in calcified tissue. After 2 months, the lesion became infected. Despite multiple debridements, antibiotics, and negative pressure wound therapy, the infection progressed and ultimately resulted in right-sided infective endocarditis. Magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated that calcinosis was confined to the medial gastrocnemius. Given persistent infection and failure of conservative treatment, a multidisciplinary team performed complete surgical excision of the medial gastrocnemius and its calcified extension into the Achilles tendon. Postoperative recovery was uncomplicated, and the patient regained full function. At 1 year, imaging showed no recurrence of calcinosis and full integrity of the Achilles tendon. This Case Report demonstrates that, in selected cases, when calcinosis is confined to a single muscle, complete surgical excision can provide a definitive cure, restore function, and prevent recurrence.

items.titleZh: 青少年皮肌炎腓肠肌钙质沉着症：一例成功手术治疗报告
items.abstractZh: 青少年皮肌炎是一种罕见的儿童炎症性肌病，以近端肌无力和典型皮肤病变为特征。尽管大多数患者达到缓解，但高达40%的患者出现钙质沉着，可能导致显著的长期发病率。治疗仍具挑战性，且由于复发、异位骨化和功能损害的风险，通常不鼓励手术干预。本病例描述一名45岁男性，有长期缓解的青少年皮肌炎病史，出现右小腿自发性无痛性肿胀。影像学显示腓肠肌内广泛钙化和软组织水肿，最初被解释为钙化组织中的血肿。2个月后，病灶发生感染。尽管多次清创、使用抗生素和负压伤口治疗，感染仍进展，最终导致右侧感染性心内膜炎。磁共振成像显示钙质沉着局限于内侧腓肠肌。鉴于持续感染和保守治疗失败，多学科团队对内侧腓肠肌及其延伸至跟腱的钙化部分进行了完全手术切除。术后恢复顺利，患者完全恢复功能。1年时，影像学显示无钙质沉着复发，跟腱完整性良好。本病例报告表明，在特定病例中，当钙质沉着局限于单一肌肉时，完全手术切除可提供根治性治愈、恢复功能并预防复发。

items.title: Subcutaneous golimumab in the treatment of Juvenile idiopathic arthritis-associated anterior uveitis after failing other tumor necrosis factor alpha inhibitors.
items.abstract: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of subcutaneous (SQ) golimumab (GLM) in patients with juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA)-associated anterior uveitis who failed prior tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-α) inhibitors. This retrospective case series included 16 eyes from 8 patients with JIA associated anterior uveitis who had previously failed at least one TNF-α inhibitor. Data collected included demographics, previous treatments, best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA), and uveitis severity. Assessments were made at baseline, and at 3, 6, and 12 months following SQ GLM initiation. Eight patients (87.5% female, all white) with an average age of 18.6 years were included. Uveitis was bilateral and chronic in all cases. Five patients (62.5%) achieved remission after SQ GLM. The average logarithm of the minimum angle of resolution improved significantly from 0.11 at baseline before starting treatment to 0.03 at 12 months after starting treatment ( P = 0.006). No cystoid macular edema developed during the follow-up. SQ GLM was discontinued in three patients due to ineffectiveness and/or other reasons. No significant correlations were found between response to SQ GLM and clinical variables. No adverse effects were observed during the study period. SQ GLM shows promise in treating JIA associated anterior uveitis, especially in cases without severe complications. Significant improvement in BCVA and inflammation control suggests its potential as a treatment option, although further studies with larger populations are needed to confirm these findings.

items.titleZh: 皮下注射戈利木单抗治疗对其他肿瘤坏死因子α抑制剂无效的幼年特发性关节炎相关前葡萄膜炎
items.abstractZh: 旨在评估皮下注射（SQ）戈利木单抗（GLM）对既往使用肿瘤坏死因子α（TNF-α）抑制剂失败的幼年特发性关节炎（JIA）相关前葡萄膜炎患者的疗效和安全性。本回顾性病例系列研究纳入8例JIA相关前葡萄膜炎患者的16只眼，这些患者既往至少对一种TNF-α抑制剂治疗失败。收集的数据包括人口统计学特征、既往治疗、最佳矫正视力（BCVA）和葡萄膜炎严重程度。在基线以及SQ GLM开始后3、6和12个月进行评估。共纳入8例患者（87.5%为女性，均为白人），平均年龄18.6岁。所有病例均为双侧慢性葡萄膜炎。5例患者（62.5%）在SQ GLM治疗后达到缓解。最小分辨角对数平均值从治疗开始前基线的0.11显著改善至治疗开始后12个月的0.03（P = 0.006）。随访期间未发生黄斑囊样水肿。3例患者因疗效不佳和/或其他原因停用SQ GLM。SQ GLM应答与临床变量之间未发现显著相关性。研究期间未观察到不良事件。SQ GLM在治疗JIA相关前葡萄膜炎方面显示出前景，尤其是在无严重并发症的病例中。BCVA的显著改善和炎症控制提示其作为治疗选择的潜力，但仍需更大样本量的进一步研究来证实这些发现。
